_comment: SEE tools/session-root-hooks.json's role in CLAUDE.md — 'Saving work' section. This is NOT read directly by Claude Code; it must be COPIED to /home/user/.claude/settings.json (the actual session root, one level above this repo) as the FIRST action of every session. Confirmed 2026-09-10: this environment (Claude Code on the web, a multi-repo container) does not load hooks from a repo subdirectory's own .claude/settings.json — CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is unset and the harness apparently only checks one designated project root for the whole session. Writing the identical hook config to /home/user/.claude/settings.json instead made it fire immediately, live-tested. Unlike this repo's own .claude/settings.json (single-repo, uses CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR), every command here loops over ALL repos directly under /home/user so it protects every project in the container, not just this one.

hooks.command: for d in /home/user/*/; do [ -f "$d/tools/resume.sh" ] && [ -d "$d/.git" ] && (cd "$d" && bash tools/resume.sh); done 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Reading where the last session stopped...

hooks.command: for d in /home/user/*/; do [ -f "$d/tools/autosave.sh" ] && [ -d "$d/.git" ] && (cd "$d" && bash tools/autosave.sh); done 2>/dev/null || true
for d in /home/user/*/; do [ -f "$d/tools/autosave.sh" ] && [ -d "$d/.git" ] && (cd "$d" && bash tools/autosave.sh); done 2>/dev/null || true
for d in /home/user/*/; do [ -f "$d/tools/toobig.sh" ] && [ -d "$d/.git" ] && (cd "$d" && bash tools/toobig.sh); done 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Session is large — saving before compaction...
